reviews.title: Working Well
reviews.comment: Sketchy packaging, but it was wrapped up in multiple layers of bubble wrap. Arrived on time, popped my 32gb kit into a brand new MoBo entered the BIOS, enabled EXPO, and its running at 6000mhz no problem.
reviews.author: Dustie Lachelle

reviews.title: The foot print and version match the motherboard to be used on
reviews.comment: The memory boards worked great, however do not try installing on your own, have a professional do it. The new motherboards are very delicate, and the types of board may not match the mother board you are installing it in.
reviews.author: John Engel

reviews.title: Worth the cash ( right now)
reviews.comment: Runs in sweet spot 6000Mz no problems on point  Asus x870-p and  Ryzen 9700x . In the market now hard to find anything close.. working great
reviews.author: Bob
